**Height:** 164 cm (5'5")

She is a silver-haired half-elf girl who is one of the candidates to become the next ruler in the royal election. [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) first meets her when her insignia is stolen by [Felt](https://anilist.co/character/88574/Felt) as she needs to possess it to be eligible to participate in the election. She introduces herself as Satella when she and Subaru met during the first timeline before introducing herself by her real name when she got her insignia back.

Emilia is good natured and likes to take care of others, though she herself refuses to admit it, instead thinking of it as her own selfishness. She is indifferent to her own appearance, leaving [Puck](https://anilist.co/character/90187/Puck) to take care of her clothes and hair. Because her appearance is similar to the [Witch of Envy](https://anilist.co/character/127242/Satella), she has received unfair discrimination from others. She sometimes acts like a child and is unacquainted with the world as she used to live in the woods with other Elves, though despite this she still works hard to become a ruler.

Puck is an Artificial Spirit that [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/88572/Emilia) was formerly contracted with. He is the current Great Spirit of Fire.

~!He is currently known as the Beast of The End.!~

~!Around 400 years ago, Puck was created by Echidna, though he had apparently left her by the time she moved into the Sanctuary. Seven years before the start of the election, Puck unfroze Emilia and began to act as her friend and mentor, and later on started to live at Roswaal's mansion where he was reunited with Beatrice.!~

Puck can be described as cute or adorable, thus his skin being pink around his cheeks. His fur is mostly grey with silver in certain spots (i.e. tip of the tail). His eyebrows are pretty small and rhombus-shaped. He also has a gold earring on his left ear. Sometimes, he carries a purple bag.

Puck is generally a nice spirit. He is very happy and stays at Emilia's side to protect her, affectionately calling her "Lia". He occasionally goofs around and gets along especially well with [Beatrice](https://anilist.co/character/90181/Beatrice). 

~!However, Puck's demeanor greatly changes in loops where Emilia dies, showing a complete disregard for anyone except her, and was even willing to destroy the world because of the condition in their contract.!~

Julius doesn't like those who forget their place, leading him to have bad relations with [Subaru](https://anilist.co/character/88573/Natsuki-Subaru) for a while. While both have apologized to each other after the battle with the Hakugei, Subaru told him he still hated him. Julius said he didn't intend to be friends. They both became very intimate very quickly during the planning and attacking the Witch Cult. In the end, Julius directly considered Subaru as his friend.

personajes.descripcion:
Roy Alphard is a Sin Archbishop of the Witch Cult, representing the bizarre eating aspect of gluttony. 
He has long disheveled brown hair, with green eyes that are yellow are the center and teeth shaped like sharp fangs. He wears a small piece of cloth around his body as clothing.


Unlike his brother Lye, Roy doesn’t care about what he consumes nor does he place any special emphasis on who he wants to eat like his sister Louis. As “bizarre eating” of gluttony, his approach towards his meals is much more casual, emphasizing quantity over quality. In combat unlike Lye he does not give his opponents a chance and likes to exploit their weaknesses to completely destroy them. 


~! 
Like Lye and Louis, Roy has two similar skills shared between the gluttony’s 

Roy has access to “Authority of Gluttony”, unlike other types of authority there are different forms and effects that come from being affected by the authority.

Roy can eat a name and memories of an individual. To achieve eating a name he touches the individual with his left hand, then licks the palm of the same hand. Roy can then take things such as experience, talent, likes and dislikes of human relationships and they can serve as food for him, allowing him to take advantage of any abilities or memories his opponents had. 

Those that have their names eaten have their existences erased from the world. This will end any human relationships and remove any contracts with spirits
Those who have their memories eaten become amnesic and any types of characteristics they had previous are removed.
Those who have their name and memories eaten become an empty shell, while they are still alive they no longer require the need to eat,excrete waste or age. 

While this ability is powerful on paper it has two major drawbacks

If Roy eats a fake name or memory he will become plagued with severe nausea.
Roy is also unable to eat the same person twice until that individual has gained enough new memories or has established a different sense of self from their old existence.  

!~

personajes.descripcion:
Clind is a house steward serving the Miload Family. He is well-mannered, highly considerate of others, is extremely skilled as a servant, and tends to add idioms to the end of his sentences.

~!Being born before the Great Calamity, Clind was acquainted with the Witches and Warlocks of that era. At some point in time, he made a contract with a young Roswaal A Mathers which entailed Clind to protect Roswaal's property by any and all means. According to Roswaal, he had compensated the contract with Clind by forming a united front and defeating Roswaal's yet-unnamed nemesis. Clind has faithfully abided to his contract ever since, due to his ability to perceive souls and sensing Roswaal A Mathers' soul in the bodies of his descendants.

At some point in the future, Clind came in contact with an unspecified Witch Factor, which granted him an Authority he possesses to this day.

Following the end of the Demi-Human War, Clind accompanied Roswaal J Mathers (Julia Mathers) to a pub where she met with the Sword Demon, Wilhelm van Astrea, where they discussed the threat of Stride Vollachia. During their talk, however, the trio were assaulted by a group of Shinobi, who were swiftly dispatched by Roswaal, Wilhelm, and Clind. Wilhelm noted that Clind's technique was neither sword skill nor magic, but something completely different.

Sometime in the following decades, Clind was entrusted with protecting and training Frederica Baumann. During that period, he was also transferred to Miload Manor, where he actively continues to work as Annerose Miload's butler.!~
